hypotheses.E0_full_embedding_router_replicates: The full embedding router agrees with the prior aggregate operator fidelity within 1e-5 on every corpus.
hypotheses.E1_embedding_geometry_generalizes_unseen: On token identities absent from discovery, the embedding router exceeds the coarse-class router by at least 0.02 on every corpus.
hypotheses.E2_embedding_geometry_beats_response_nul: On unseen token identities, the real embedding router exceeds the p95 of 32 coarse-class-and-position-matched response permutations by at least 0.03 on every corpus.
hypotheses.E3_context_span_contains_a_usable_lexica: A ridge router restricted to the 16 tensor context directions reaches at least 0.75 aggregate operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.E4_embedding_router_is_output_low_rank: A rank-8 truncation of the 16-output embedding map remains within 0.02 operator fidelity of the full map on every corpus.
hypotheses.E5_embedding_and_context_input_subspaces: The mean canonical cosine between the embedding-router input span and tensor context span is at least 0.50.
hypotheses.E6_unseen_identity_cost_is_bounded: Embedding-router fidelity on unseen identities is within 0.15 of fidelity on seen identities on every corpus.
hypotheses.E7_geometry_beats_lookup_on_unseen_ident: On unseen identities, the embedding router exceeds the exact-token table, which falls back to its mean, by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
